Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: provisional model sheet for Neet & Buddy Chronicles, for independent anatomical review, not owner-approved canon.
Make a spacious landscape character sheet on warm ivory paper, delicate dark brown pen contours and transparent restrained watercolor, observational editorial-story illustration, accurately drawn real dogs with restrained expressive eyes, no chibi or giant puppy heads.
Six full-body standing studies arranged TWO ROWS, THREE COLUMNS: top row NEET front, left-facing side, front three-quarter; bottom row BUDDY front, left-facing side, front three-quarter. Each dog's row stays consistent. Both rows share an illustrative qualitative scale but exact relative size is unverified; no ruler/measurements. Each pose shows the full dog with generous whitespace and tiny ground shadow, all limb connections/support clear. Simple labels "Neet" and "Buddy" at row left, no other text.
Reference images 1-3 are Neet: image1 N19 side body/legs/nub, image2 N29 front chest/fine legs, image3 N27 side-rear real trunk volume. Neet is a small tall-looking tan/golden-fawn smooth very short-coated dog, fine long legs under a real full narrow torso, modest rounded head, tapering PROJECTING muzzle, broad-rooted large cupped triangular ears, cream muzzle/chin/throat with irregular cream chest bib, black nose and lip rims, brown dark-rimmed eyes. Tiny rump nub only, not a longer tail. No white high socks, no black saddle, no emaciation, no fox or rabbit ears.
Reference images 4-7 are Buddy: image4 B04 front substantial legs and chest pattern; image5 B23 projecting muzzle/turned standing; image6 B29 continuous moderately elongated torso and slender dark low-curved tail, SIDE STRIDE ONLY not neutral stance; image7 B26 head/ear hair direction only, body cropped under harness. Use one consistent fairly tidy photographed grooming state anchored B04/B23: close charcoal torso, deep chest, visible neck, moderately elongated continuous trunk, real substantial legs/clearance, modest head, projecting muzzle, cream irregular moustache and short beard, light curved brows, softly pendant ear flaps with straight gray/tan hair, pale tan chest fields flanking dark throat, pale lower legs/feet. Not a sausage dog, not floor-length fluff, not a square generic terrier. Full connected spine/ribcage/pelvis, credible shoulder/hip roots, four legs only per dog.
Photos govern likeness only in their visible regions. N19 head turned/far legs overlap, N29 foreshortens body, N27 grass obscures feet. B04/B23 perspective foreshortens torso and grass hides toes; B29 blurred moving pose cannot fix neutral ratios. No calibrated proportions/breed/weight/motion/psychology inferred. Exclude N35 anatomy, B08 anatomy, unavailable B25; B30 supplemental rest only and not used here. One exposure counts once, B04/B24 same exposure. No human figures, collars/costumes, comic symbols, invented accessories or scenery. Do not copy photographic backgrounds. Warm observational line/wash with natural canine geometry is the provisional style.

arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: provisional paired REST AND ACTION model test, for independent review, not approved canon. Spacious landscape sheet TWO horizontal vignettes top and bottom on warm ivory paper, delicate brown pen contours and restrained transparent watercolor, real canine geometry and restrained expressions, no chibi.
TOP vignette: two dogs together resting on the same simple flat neutral rug, angled three-quarter toward viewer, separated so limbs belong unmistakably to each dog. Left NEET, tan smooth very short coat, lies sternally with both fine forelegs extended and fully connected shoulders, small paws resting on rug, rounded torso continuing to tucked rear legs. Right BUDDY, charcoal with pale muzzle/brows/lower legs, lies chin resting on his forepaws, an unbroken moderately elongated torso receding behind him, haunch attached, legs folded credibly. His top-view grooming uses the photographed longer ear fringe and irregular moustache of reference4 only; torso remains closely groomed, NOT uniformly shaggy. Camera slightly above body height so torso connectivity stays visible, neither dog clipped by canvas. Small label "Rest".
BOTTOM vignette: two dogs together with all bodies fully visible. Neet at left standing naturally facing right, quiet surprised alert attention to Buddy. Buddy at right intercepting a single orange tennis ball, mouth open toward ball, forepaws lifted and bent, hind legs provide credible contact with ground, continuous full torso and visible neck. Use action photo image5 as grounding for Buddy's pose and its close-groomed FACE/EARS variant; this is the same Buddy in photographed short-groom state, not a new breed. Draw hindfeet support and leg ownership clearly; no extra legs or paws. Neet is planted on four slender legs with real narrow-full torso volume, broad-rooted triangular ears and tiny nub tail, small head and projecting cream muzzle. Small label "Action".
Input roles: image1 N19 standing Neet side construction and tiny nub; image2 N25 sternal Neet rest, forelegs/ears only, hindfeet and tail hidden; image3 B29 Buddy elongated torso, visible neck, leg clearance and thin dark tapering tail, captured stride (not neutral ratio or gait evidence); image4 B19 Buddy chin-down rest and irregular pale facial/ear hair, near face perspective enlarged so DO NOT copy that head/body ratio; image5 B12 Buddy single ball-interception pose and close-groomed face/ears, ball obscures mouth and this does not establish catch timing.
Identity: Neet long fine legs; real narrow full ribcage, gently rounded forehead, modest head, large broad cupped triangular ears not rabbit ears; fawn/golden smooth coat, cream muzzle/chin/throat/irregular bib, black nose/lip rims, dark-rimmed brown eyes. No long tail, high white socks, hard black saddle, emaciation.
Buddy continuous moderately elongated full dark charcoal torso, deep chest, substantial legs and clearance; modest head and clearly projecting muzzle; pale irregular moustache/beard, light curved brows, dark eye surrounds, hanging soft ears; pale tan chest fields flanking dark throat, pale lower legs/feet. Regional hair, no giant plush head, sausage proportions or square terrier. Slender predominantly dark tapering tail modest fringe only; no permanent ring.
Restrictions: only visible original regions establish anatomy; exact measurements/relative size, ancestry, weight, colors, motion and psychology unverified. B29 moving blurred pose cannot fix neutral ratios; B19 perspective cannot fix whole-body proportions; N25 hides rear. N35 excludes anatomy, B08 styling-only, B25 unavailable, B30 supplemental rest and not used; one photographic exposure counts once. Human model absent; no humans. No clothing, speech balloons, scenery clutter, extra props or comic symbols. Make pose connectivity legible over decorative finish.
